description: Returns recent log entries of an app, oldest first: what its handlers wrote with ctx.log, handler errors with stack traces, and platform events such as deploys. Pass the returned cursor as since to read only newer entries.

app.description: The app's slug: the first label of its address (my-app for https://my-app.fuast.com). list_apps shows the slugs you can use.

edit_token.description: The edit_token deploy_app returned when it deployed a preview without an account. It is a secret: keep it in this conversation only.

level.description: Lowest level to return. Default info.

since.description: Cursor from an earlier call: only entries after it.

name: get_logs
title: Read an app's logs
